body: Yes, `parse a sizes attribute` runs the exact same algorithm for both `` and ``. What forks the behavior is `allows auto-sizes`: - `allows auto-sizes` requires `img`'s own sizes attribute to literally be "auto" or start with "auto", alongside loading="lazy". - On ``, if auto isn't first (e.g. `sizes="(max-width: 0px) 10px, auto, 300px")`, `img` itself fails allows auto-sizes. - On ``, `parse a sizes attribute` is called with ``'s sizes string and the following img element. If that img has `loading="lazy" sizes="auto"`, then img does allow auto-sizes — the algorithm still resolves `auto` if earlier entries didn't match (consistent with how a bare `` in the middle of a list is a parse error in the grammar but still accepted by the parser).
